title: dryas integrifolia subsp. chamissonis
intro: Dryas integrifolia subsp. chamissonis, commonly known as Chamisson's Mountain Avens, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of western North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryas integrifolia subsp. chamissonis include wound healing, pain relief, and the reduction of inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
